defs.def: a state of peaceful existence and agreement 融洽；和睦
the way in which different notes that are played or sung together combine to make a pleasing sound 和声
a pleasing combination of related things 和谐；协调

ex.s: People can live in harmony with grizzlies.
ex.t: 人类可以与灰熊和谐共处。

ex.s: To ensure harmony in care homes.
We should live in harmony with nature．
ex.t: 我们应该与自然和谐相处．

ex.s: The harmony of old and new.
In this way, we could learn to exist in harmony with these wild animals and ensure our continued co-existence on the planet that we all share.
ex.t: 通过这种方式，我们可以学会与这些野生动物和谐共存，并确保我们在这个我们共同拥有的星球上继续共存下去。

ex.s: Nor would they fail to imagine how its native inhabitants, including royal penguins, king penguins, and elephant seals, existed in perfect harmony with their natural habitat for thousands of years.
ex.t: 他们也不会不想到，岛上的原始居民——包括皇家企鹅、王企鹅和象海豹——是如何与它们的自然栖息地完美和谐地共存了数千年。

ex.s: This is just one of the ways in which people of Shennongjia live and work in harmony with nature.
ex.t: 这只是神农架人与自然和谐相处和工作的方式之一。

ex.s: Creating buildings such as these enables us to live in closer harmony with our environment.
ex.t: 建造这样的建筑使我们能够与我们的环境更加和谐地生活在一起。
